0022600021.text: Dallas hosts Houston in Emirates NBA Cup West Group A play, with the Mavericks (3-2, on a two-game win streak) sitting 7th in the West and 2 games back in the Southwest, while the unbeaten Rockets (5-0, on a five-game win streak) lead both the Southwest and the West. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Houston is missing Alperen Sengun (back soreness), Reed Sheppard (back), and Steven Adams (calf strain). The Mavericks trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 128-110 loss in Houston on October 21, and the teams split 2-2 in 2025-26.
